- DIAGNOSTIC (REMOTE60_CONTROL_CLOSE_DIAG, the PinnedSelectTest host + its unit test only; GNLinkStream without it):
  udp_control_channel.cpp/hpp, host_startup_control.cpp, CMake -- byte-identical to the old tree's ff98f19 diff for the
  channel (results 31dcfffd / 9eb7520c). udp_control_close_diag_test 6/6 here and there.
- relay trace for BOTH refs (oa_relay_trace_server.py --ref new|old): new = 53fced4 server.js 2742143d -> 18f6b6d2
  (relay_trace_53fced4.diff 9883b4db, replaces r7f's 52918c04); old = fae0e1f server.js fdc9cbe8 (= the NAS's, read
  2026-10-30, all 8 runtime files equal) -> 196405dd (relay_trace_fae0e1f.diff e7d993eb: 7a79b09's hunks that apply +
  its client->host forward re-cut by hand; its standby hunks have nothing to attach to -- fae0e1f has no standby relay).
  Both: each periodic snap carries the 1 s buckets of the seconds completed since the previous snap (the fixture kills
  Node by its handle: no close line). relay_trace_snap_test.js: the server killed after one sweep -> a snap already
  holds c2h/h2c header buckets. check, per ref: 7a79b09 relay_trace_test ALL PASS + snap test ALL PASS on the traced
  copy (POSITIVE); the base with the variable set FAILs "the trace says it is on" (NEGATIVE); the r7f copy (52918c04)
  FAILs the snap test (snaps=2, with buckets=0).
- oa_avd OA_SCOPE=to-3w / oa_slot -Scope to-3w (recorded in slot.txt): the arm ends after the 30 s watch, 4-7 NOT RUN by
  scope, no input after it. oa_pick_test 76/76 (+ to-3w: exit 0, no picture tap, 4-7 NOT RUN by scope; contrast: without
  it the same flow taps the picture).
- oa_ref_builddir.ps1: one run's build folder -- the four lane tools + ONE chosen GNLinkStreamPinnedSelectTest.exe,
  hashed, with the host's own strings (close record, power OFF line, seam) counted.
No real run.
